title: Sloth bear mum: 'Are we there yet?'
storyboard: Film: actor on all fours as sloth bear mum, two plush 'cubs' on her back, kitchen floor, 2 takes

scenes.headline: Sloth bear mum: 'Everyone hold on to the saddle.'
Cub: 'Are we there yet? Can we get termites?'
Sloth bear cubs really do ride on mum's back
scenes.body: Mothers have an extra shag of fur on the back, called a 'saddle', that cubs cling to.

caption:
The original carpool.

Sloth bears have flexible lips and nostrils that can close. They blow dirt away to uncover insects, then suck them up like a vacuum.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Family-road-trip skit (actor as mum with plush cubs on back) over a wild Bor Tiger Reserve photo of a real mum carrying cubs; every gag maps to a true sloth bear trait.
